item.title: My Laptop Won't Charge
item.summary: A customer calls tech support because his laptop isn't charging, and together they find the cause step by step.
item.transcript_text:
Sam: Hello, you're through to TechHelp support. My name's Sam. How can I help you today?
Rustam: Hi, Sam. My laptop isn't charging. I plugged it in last night, and this morning the battery was still at five percent.
Sam: OK, let's try to sort it out. First, when you plug the charger in, does the little light on the side come on?
Rustam: No, nothing happens at all.
Sam: Right. Have you tried a different socket? Sometimes the problem is the socket, not the laptop.
Rustam: Oh, I haven't. Hold on. No, still nothing.
Sam: OK. Could you check the cable for any damage, especially near the ends?
Rustam: Actually, yes. It's a bit bent near the plug. My cat likes chewing cables, so...
Sam: That's probably the cause, then. The good news is that your laptop is likely fine. You just need a new charger.
Rustam: Phew. Is it covered by the warranty?
Sam: I'm afraid the warranty doesn't cover damage to cables. But I can order a new one for you, and delivery is free. It should arrive in two or three working days.
Rustam: That's fine. Thanks for your help.
